name: ytdl
description: Invoke the user's yt-dlp toolkit on Ops for original-language YouTube transcripts, optional ASR fallback and media tasks.

interface.longDescription: Extract original-language YouTube transcript tracks first, use local ASR only if original captions are unavailable. Also handle other media via Ops.
defaultPrompt: Extract this YouTube video transcript in its original spoken language; never auto-translate it.
Show the available formats for this URL.
Transcribe speech in this Instagram Reel to TXT and SRT.
